title: Disagree and recap in an international meeting
summary: Phản biện lịch sự, xử lý câu hỏi tiếp theo và chốt quyết định có owner.

sections.title: Meeting proposal
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Proposal: skip the three-hour load test to keep Friday's launch. Current evidence: staging has handled only 20% of forecast traffic. Minh can run the critical scenario at forecast traffic from 13:00 to 16:00. The go/no-go threshold is p95 latency at or below 500ms and an error rate below 1%. Lan is the release owner and will lead the decision at 16:15. Rollback ownership is not assigned, and all new assignments remain proposals until the group confirms them.

expressions.phrase: I see the ___ concern; I’m not comfortable with ___ because ___.
expressions.meaning: Acknowledge a shared goal before stating an evidence-backed concern.
expressions.example: I see the schedule concern; I’m not comfortable skipping the test because staging covers only 20% of forecast traffic.
alternatives: I understand ___; my concern is ___ because ___.

expressions.phrase: Could we ___ and make ___ conditional on ___?
expressions.meaning: Offer a collaborative alternative with an explicit condition.
expressions.example: Could we run the scenario and make launch conditional on meeting both thresholds?
alternatives: Would it work to ___, provided that ___?

expressions.meaning: Recap an owner and deadline without presenting an unconfirmed assignment as decided.
expressions.example: Subject to agreement, Minh could complete the test by 16:00.
alternatives: My proposal, pending confirmation, is that ___ completes ___ by ___.

sections.title: Disagree and close the decision constructively

exercises.question: Mở đầu nào phản biện rõ nhưng không đối đầu?
options: I see the schedule concern; I’m not comfortable skipping the load test because staging covers only 20% of forecast traffic.
I agree with the deadline, so the evidence does not matter.
correctAnswer: I see the schedule concern; I’m not comfortable skipping the load test because staging covers only 20% of forecast traffic.
exercises.explanation: Acknowledge mục tiêu chung rồi nêu concern kèm evidence thay vì công kích hoặc bỏ qua risk.

exercises.question: Which result supports a go decision under the current proposal?
options: p95 is 480ms and the error rate is 0.8%.
p95 is 480ms and the error rate is 1.4%.
The test finishes at 16:00 but no metrics are recorded.
correctAnswer: p95 is 480ms and the error rate is 0.8%.
exercises.explanation: Both supplied thresholds must pass: p95 at or below 500ms and error rate below 1%.

exercises.question: How should the recap distinguish Lan from Minh and the rollback owner?
options: Lan's decision role and time are confirmed; Minh and the rollback assignment remain proposals pending group confirmation.
All three roles are confirmed because Lan is the release owner.
All three roles remain proposals, including Lan's stated decision role.
correctAnswer: Lan's decision role and time are confirmed; Minh and the rollback assignment remain proposals pending group confirmation.
exercises.explanation: The evidence confirms Lan's existing release-owner role and decision time, while new assignments for Minh and rollback ownership still require group confirmation.

performanceTask.title: Challenge and close the decision
performanceTask.scenario: Trong cuộc họp release, nhóm muốn bỏ một quality gate để giữ deadline.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dựa trên meeting evidence đang hiển thị và phản hồi mà chưa xem model hoặc chunk bank.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Trong 60–90 giây bằng tiếng Anh, acknowledge mục tiêu, nêu disagreement có evidence, đề xuất go/no-go threshold và recap owner, deadline, confirmation state; phân biệt vai trò đã xác nhận với assignment mới còn là proposal.
performanceTask.modelResponse: I understand why we want to protect Friday’s date. I’m not comfortable skipping the load test because staging has covered only twenty percent of forecast traffic. Could Minh run the critical scenario from one to four and make launch conditional on p95 staying at or below five hundred milliseconds and errors below one percent? Lan is the confirmed release owner and will lead the go/no-go decision at 4:15. Subject to group agreement, Minh could own the test by four, and a rollback owner should be confirmed before the decision. To recap, Lan’s decision role and time are confirmed; Minh and rollback ownership remain proposed assignments pending confirmation.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dùng retry evidence mới, sửa tiêu chí trọng tâm và kết thúc bằng proposed decision recap rõ ràng.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dùng security-review evidence, phản biện và recap phương án thay thế mà không xem model/chunks.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Trong 60–90 giây, dùng accessibility evidence mới và đề xuất owner/deadline mà không xem model/chunks.

rubric.description: Acknowledges the shared goal before disagreeing.
